title: HR Generalist
summary: Supports the employee lifecycle: recruitment coordination, onboarding, employee relations, and HR administration.
bullets: Coordinated end-to-end recruitment for X roles, reducing time-to-fill by Y%
Onboarded N new hires with structured checklists and 30-day follow-ups
Advised managers on policy queries and escalated complex cases appropriately
Maintained accurate employee records and supported audit readiness

title: HR Business Partner
summary: Partners with business leaders on people strategy, performance, structure, and change.
bullets: Advised leadership on org design and headcount planning for a team of N
Improved performance review completion rate from X% to Y%
Coached managers through sensitive employee relations cases
Led people workstream for a change initiative affecting N employees

title: Marketing Executive
summary: Plans and executes campaigns across digital and offline channels to generate demand and brand awareness.
bullets: Ran multi-channel campaigns that increased leads by X% quarter-over-quarter
Managed social calendar and improved engagement rate by Y%
Produced weekly performance reports and recommended optimisations
Coordinated agencies and internal teams to deliver campaigns on time

title: Software Engineer
summary: Designs, builds, and maintains software systems with a focus on reliability and user value.
bullets: Built and shipped features used by N users with measurable performance gains
Improved API response times by X% through query and caching optimisations
Wrote automated tests that reduced production incidents
Collaborated with product and design in iterative delivery cycles

title: Sales Executive
summary: Generates revenue by prospecting, qualifying, and closing deals while managing client relationships.
bullets: Exceeded sales target by X% through disciplined pipeline management
Closed N new accounts with average deal size of Y
Maintained accurate CRM data and forecast reliability
Built long-term relationships that drove repeat business

title: Operations Coordinator
summary: Keeps day-to-day operations running smoothly through process, coordination, and problem-solving.
bullets: Coordinated cross-team workflows that reduced handoff delays
Standardised SOPs and trained team members on updated processes
Tracked KPIs and flagged risks early to leadership
Managed vendor schedules and resolved operational blockers quickly

title: Customer Support Specialist
summary: Resolves customer issues across channels while protecting satisfaction and retention.
bullets: Handled N tickets/week with CSAT of X%
Reduced average resolution time by Y% through better macros and triage
Documented FAQs that lowered repeat contacts
Escalated complex cases with clear context for faster resolution

title: Accountant
summary: Maintains accurate financial records, reporting, and compliance support for the organisation.
bullets: Managed monthly close activities and delivered reports on schedule
Reconciled accounts and resolved discrepancies before audit
Supported tax/VAT filings with complete supporting schedules
Improved invoice processing turnaround by X%
